links.outcome: Identification of confirmed inflammatory breast cancer cases
links.effect: Sensitivity 92.2% (235 of 255 confirmed cases); 57 (22.4%) identified solely through the NLP pipeline and would have been missed by traditional surveillance
links.tradeoff: Specificity 14.1% (61 false positives among 71 non-IBC cases) and NPV 33.3%; human-in-the-loop time commitment remains and the authors want to minimize it. Manual effort is described as lower than traditional surveillance, but no figures are given.
links.quote: Of these confirmed cases, 57 (22.4%) were identified solely through the NLP pipeline and would have been missed through traditional surveillance methods.
